editorial.blurb: Costera Cocina Tulum brings vibrant Tulum energy to Chicago's West Loop with bold, fresh Mexican and seafood dishes that shine brightest in their mains and desserts.
editorial.insiderTip: Order during Chicago Restaurant Week (4 courses for $60) to sample their strengths—the pasta with langosta and ceviche are standouts—and don't skip the churros; arrive early to secure parking in the busy Fulton Market area.
